connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Official GitHub MCP server for repository, issue, pull request, code search, and Actions workflows. A GitHub account and token or OAuth authorization are required; normal GitHub account access applies.

connectors.name: Filesystem
connectors.description: Local file read, write, directory, and search operations restricted to explicitly allowed paths. Runs locally; no paid API subscription required.

connectors.name: Fetch
connectors.description: Fetch public web pages and convert content to readable Markdown. Runs locally and requires no paid API key.

connectors.name: Git
connectors.description: Inspect local Git repositories, commits, diffs, branches, and repository history. Runs locally with access limited to the configured repository paths.

connectors.name: Knowledge Graph Memory
connectors.description: Local persistent knowledge graph for entities, relations, and observations. No external account or paid API required.

connectors.name: Sequential Thinking
connectors.description: Structured planning and reasoning utility for step-wise task decomposition. Runs locally with no paid API key.

connectors.name: Time and Timezone
connectors.description: Read current time and convert between time zones. Runs locally with no paid API key.

connectors.name: Playwright Browser Automation
connectors.description: Automate browser navigation and interaction with Playwright. Runs locally; requires Node.js and browser installation. Browser access can have security implications.
